front: What does console.log(value?.toLowerCase()) print when value is undefined, and why?
back: undefined. Optional chaining skips toLowerCase(), but console.log still executes.

front: How do you check whether an unknown value is a primitive string?
back: typeof value === "string". TypeScript type annotations are erased; this check runs in JavaScript.

front: Why isn’t typeof value === "object" enough before reading properties?
back: typeof null returns "object", so null must be excluded before reading properties.

front: What happens in console.log(value?.toString()) when value is undefined?
back: The method call is skipped; console.log receives and prints the value undefined, not a string.

front: Does an unchecked method call on an unknown parameter compile when the caller supplies a compatible value?
back: No. The body is checked against unknown regardless of caller arguments; narrow before calling the method.

front: How do the types of findTask(7) and await findTask(7) differ?
back: Promise<Task | undefined> versus Task | undefined. Check the awaited value before accessing title.
